verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime fiction first-publication span from the first installment of I Am a Cat to the opening installments of Light and Darkness; it is a selected publishing proxy, not a complete bibliography or claim of uninterrupted work.
verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use original Japanese magazine or newspaper first appearances, including the first year of a serialization, rather than composition, completion, separate-volume publication or translation. English titles are shown for readability. I Am a Cat ran intermittently from January 1905 through August 1906 and its three separate volumes appeared from 1905 through 1907. Light and Darkness began serialization in May 1916, remained unfinished when Sōseki died that December and appeared as a separate volume posthumously in January 1917.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
